arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path='rules_test.py'; src=open(path).read()
marker = "# ---------------------------------------------------------------- odd shapes"
addition = '''# a later null plan removes internal expectations from validation
dropped = flow + [{"op": "routes", "label": "gone", "paths": None},
                  {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
ans = answers(dropped, topo=TOPO2)
val = validates(ans)[0]
check("dropping the plan leaves only external expectations",
      val["checked"] == 4 and val["failed"] == [] and
      set(val["failed"]) == set(), json.dumps(val))

# frozen confidence is never recomputed by later input changes
moved = flow + [patch(demand_set, {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 0},
                                   "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 0}}),
                {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
ans = answers(moved, settings=dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=[5, 1]), topo=TOPO2)
val = validates(ans)[0]
check("validation reuses frozen confidences, not recomputed ones",
      val["checked"] == 4 and val["passed"] == 4, json.dumps(val))

# an id validated many times keeps giving the same answer
again = flow + [{"op": "validate", "id": "r"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
ans = answers(again, topo=TOPO2)
check("validate is read-only and repeatable",
      validates(ans)[0] == validates(ans)[1] == validates(ans)[2],
      json.dumps(validates(ans)[1]))

'''
src = src.replace(marker, addition + marker)
open(path,'w').write(src)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/rules_test.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAIL|failures"; python3 tmp/rules_test.py 2>&1 | grep -c PASS
